text:
maya: heads-up  scheduling a short sync tomorrow 9am PT to align vendor freeze cadence + SKU taxonomy for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi across marketplace + SI integrations. top risks: thermal derates in eu/apac, driver freeze slips, and press double-booking.

alejandro: invite sent. shortlist agenda: 1) exact driver+fw freeze dates 2) marketplace SKU fields (max_seq, recommended_quant, power_profile, fallback_tag) 3) SI peering & signed image requirements 4) embargo cadence and rollback rules.

jin: perf team flagged H200 mid-run derate when sustained >40k tokens in eu racks. need vendor counters + reduced-TDP image option.

tara: labs note  can host parallel MI300 runs Mon-Tue if signed canaries arrive Thu EOD. require image signature + release notes attached.

vendor-bot: Current published tags (tentative): h100-fw:2025-03-11, h200-canary:v20250312, b200-img:v20250310, mi300-fw:2025-03-08, gaudi-driver:v3.2. Thermal exporter v0.7 available (sampling to 50ms). Signed image format: rwinf-<vendor>-<sku>-<sha256>.signed

marketing-lead: marketing requests a 7-business-day buffer between driver freeze and press embargo lift for partner quotes & docs. prefer US -> EU -> APAC staggered previews.

infra-bot: Note: eu-power caps ~8% lower than us-west. Recommend sku metadata include region_power_limit and thermal_counters_required=true. Also auto-alert when fallback routing triggers.

si-lead: SI asks: sample IaC for VPC peering + health-check hooks, plus a minimal test dataset (6 short, 4 long prompts). need vendor canaries signed and available 48h prior.

maya: adding a short smoke script we use. please run on canaries and share traces (thermal, kernel logs, inlet temps).


```
# smoke.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# quick smoke for canary verification
./run_inference --model gptx-large --seq 2048 --batch 1 --device 0 --tokens 50000 --log trace_id_${RANDOM}
```

alejandro: proposing a compact SKU metadata schema below that marketplace + SI can rely on. vendors, please confirm these fields are present in your manifests.

```
sku_metadata:
  sku_id: string
  vendor_tag: string
  driver_tag: string
  fw_tag: string
  max_seq: integer
  recommended_quant: string
  power_profile: string # e.g. "nominal", "reduced-tdp"
  thermal_counters_required: boolean
  sampling_ms: integer
  region_power_limit: map # { us-west: 1.0, eu-west: 0.92 }
  fallback_model_tag: string
  notes_url: string
```

jin: add sampling_ms and thermal_counters_required please. we need 50ms minimum for correlation.

maya: fallback rule proposal: during preview, if a customer's long-seq regression >8% vs our baseline, auto-route that customer to fallback_model_tag and notify #eng-runtime + partner. if cluster-wide regression >15%, auto-rollback preview.

si-lead: SI risk: if driver freeze slips >5 days we'll scope the dry-run to core flows only. vendors, that means longer validation cycles for SI cert.

marketing-lead: to avoid double-booking, please don't schedule partner press >2 weeks before confirmed driver freeze. we'll hold PR calendar for tentative dates.

vendor-bot: Reminder: meeting link https://meet.redwood.ai/partners/2765432100. Please reply in-thread with exact tags using format: "ACK + sku_tag + driver_tag + fw_tag + exporter_vX". Example: "ACK + h200-canary:v20250312 + h200-driver:v2.3 + h200-fw:2025-03-12 + exporter_v0.7"

maya: action items before the call: 1) vendors post full tags + exporter ok (vendors) 2) perf team run smoke + derate trace on canaries (jin) 3) SI prepare IaC snippet and dataset (si-lead) 4) marketplace/schema PR with fields above (alejandro) 5) marketing reserve embargo windows (marketing-lead).

alejandro: quick note on rollout cadence (draft):
- H100/B200: canary Mar 12-13 -> driver freeze Mar 18 -> US preview Mar 27 -> EU preview Apr 3 -> APAC preview Apr 10 -> public Apr 15
- H200: canary Mar 14-16 -> extended perf Mar 17-23 -> driver freeze Mar 24 -> US preview Apr 3 -> EU preview Apr 10 -> APAC preview Apr 17 -> public Apr 24 (fallback active)
- MI300/Gaudi: canary Mar 18-22 -> perf Mar 23-29 -> driver freeze Mar 30 -> preview Apr 7 -> public Apr 21

jin: H200 timeline looks optimistic. ask vendors to confirm whether they can provide reduced-tdp image for EU/APAC; otherwise propose moving H200 previews 2w later.

vendor-bot: H200 vendor tentative: acking request; investigating reduced-tdp image timeline. will post definitive tag or "cannot deliver" within 48h.

maya: OK. please reply with short ACKs so we can lock windows. I'll circulate minutes + a one-page checklist after the sync. Example reply: "ACK + h200-canary:v20250312 + exporter_v0.7". :white_check_mark:
